```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6.3, fig.height = 6.3, dpi = 300   # 6.3 in = text width of an A4 page
)

# Import required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(rstatix)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(flextable)
source(".\\utils.R")

# Table look for Word: Times New Roman, compact rows, booktabs rules
set_flextable_defaults(
  font.family = "Times New Roman", hansi.family = "Times New Roman",
  eastasia.family = "Times New Roman", cs.family = "Times New Roman",
  font.size = 10,
  padding.top = 2, padding.bottom = 2, padding.left = 4, padding.right = 4,
  theme_fun = theme_booktabs
)

# ---- Reporting helpers --------------------------------------------------

# APA-style p value: "< .001" or "= .023"
format_p_apa <- function(p) {
  if (p < .001) "< .001" else paste("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p)))
}

# One-line result for a friedman.test() object, written as markdown
report_friedman <- function(ft) {
  sprintf(
    "Friedman rank sum test on MAE across models: *\u03c7*^2^(%d) = %.2f, *p* %s.",
    as.integer(ft$parameter), unname(ft$statistic), format_p_apa(ft$p.value)
  )
}

# Numbers to text with 3 decimals; very small non-zero values in scientific notation
format_num <- function(x) {
  out <- formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 3)
  tiny <- !is.na(x) & x != 0 & abs(x) < 0.001
  out[tiny] <- formatC(x[tiny], format = "e", digits = 2)
  out[is.na(x)] <- ""
  out
}

# Turn any results data frame into a Word table:
# first column left-aligned, the rest right-aligned (as in the old kable calls)
word_table <- function(df) {
  df <- as.data.frame(df)
  if (.row_names_info(df) > 0) {             # keep meaningful row names as a column
    df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(df, var = "rowname")
  }
  df <- dplyr::mutate(df, dplyr::across(dplyr::where(is.double), format_num))

  ft <- flextable(df)
  if ("rowname" %in% names(df)) ft <- set_header_labels(ft, rowname = "")
  ft <- theme_booktabs(ft)
  ft <- align(ft, align = "right", part = "all")
  ft <- align(ft, j = 1, align = "left", part = "all")
  autofit(ft)
}
```

## Valence

```{r friedman-valence}
friedman_valence <- friedman.test(MAE ~ Model | X, data = valence_data)
```

`r report_friedman(friedman_valence)`

```{r wilcox-valence, tab.id = "wilcox_valence", tab.cap = "Outcomes of Wilcoxon signed-ranks pairwise post hoc tests for models predicting valence responses."}
wilcox_valence <- wilcox_test(MAE ~ Model, data = valence_data, paired = TRUE, p.adjust.method = "bonferroni", detailed = TRUE)

cliff_delta_valence <- get_cliff_delta(valence_data)

word_table(extract_wilcox_table(wilcox_valence, cliff_delta_valence))
```

## Model error distributions (paper Figure 3)

```{r mae-boxplots, fig.id = "mae_boxplots", fig.cap = "Mean absolute error (MAE) of each model for valence, tense arousal and energetic arousal."}
library(ggplot2)

plot_results <- function(data, title, limits, breaks) {
  plot <- ggboxplot(data,x = "Model",y = "MAE",fill = "grey85", colour = "black",palette = "jco",
                    alpha = 0.6,add = "jitter",add.params = list(alpha = 0.4, size = 1, jitter = 0.2)) +
    theme_pubr() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",     # remove redundant legend
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 1, size = 12),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(x = "Model Type",y = "Mean Absolute Error (MAE)",title = title) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = limits,breaks = breaks)
  return(plot)

}


valence_plot <- plot_results(data = valence_data, title = "Valence", limits = c(0.4, 0.6), breaks = seq(0.4, 0.6, by = 0.05))
tense_arousal_plot <- plot_results(data = tense_arousal_data, title = "Tense Arousal", limits = c(0.3, 0.5),breaks = seq(0.3, 0.5, by = 0.05))
energetic_arousal_plot <- plot_results(data = energetic_arousal_data, title = "Energetic Arousal", limits = c(0.2, 0.4),breaks = seq(0.2, 0.4, by = 0.05))

# arrangeGrob builds the layout without drawing it, so it appears in the document only once
boxplot_modelling <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(valence_plot, tense_arousal_plot, energetic_arousal_plot, ncol=2, nrow=2,layout_matrix=rbind(c(1,1, 2,2), c(NA, 3, 3, NA)))

# Vector version for the paper
ggsave(file="C:\\Users\\20225378\\OneDrive - TU Eindhoven\\PhD\\Experiments\\Collecting Images of Indoor Environments\\plots\\modelling_boxplot.svg", plot=boxplot_modelling, width=10, height=10)

# Word version: render at the paper's 10 x 10 in so text sizes match the SVG,
# then insert it scaled down to the page width (fig.width above)
word_png <- knitr::fig_path(".png")
dir.create(dirname(word_png), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
ggsave(word_png, plot = boxplot_modelling, width = 10, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
knitr::include_graphics(word_png, dpi = NA)   # dpi = NA: let fig.width set the size
```

## Model performance summary (paper Table 3)

```{r performance-table, tab.id = "model_performance", tab.cap = "Mean R², RMSE and MAE of each model for each response."}
data_list <- list(
  "Valence" = valence_data,
  "Tense Arousal" = tense_arousal_data,
  "Energetic Arousal" = energetic_arousal_data
)

tbl <- imap_dfr(data_list, \(dat, resp) {
  dat %>%
    group_by(Model) %>%
    summarise(
      R2 = round(mean(Rsquared, na.rm = FALSE), 2),
      RMSE = round(mean(RMSE, na.rm = FALSE), 2),
      MAE = round(mean(MAE, na.rm = FALSE), 2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    filter(Model %in% c("LR", "RF", "DFNN", "DCNN", "C-DCNN")) %>%
    mutate(Model = dplyr::recode(Model, "C-DCNN" = "CDCNN")) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Model, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Value = sprintf("%.2f", Value),
      name = paste(Model, Metric, sep = "_")
    ) %>%
    select(name, Value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = Value) %>%
    mutate(Response = resp, .before = 1)
})


tbl <- tbl %>%
  select(
    Response,
    LR_R2, LR_RMSE, LR_MAE,
    RF_R2, RF_RMSE, RF_MAE,
    DFNN_R2, DFNN_RMSE, DFNN_MAE,
    DCNN_R2, DCNN_RMSE, DCNN_MAE,
    CDCNN_R2, CDCNN_RMSE, CDCNN_MAE
  )

# -------------------------------
# Word table (flextable)
# -------------------------------
metric_cols <- setdiff(names(tbl), "Response")
metric_labels <- setNames(as.list(rep(c("R2", "RMSE", "MAE"), times = 5)), metric_cols)
thick <- fp_border_default(width = 1.5)
thin  <- fp_border_default(width = 0.75)

perf_table <- flextable(tbl) %>%
  set_header_labels(values = c(list(Response = "Response"), metric_labels)) %>%
  add_header_row(
    values = c("Response", "Linear Model", "Random Forest", "DFNN", "DCNN", "C-DCNN"),
    colwidths = c(1, 3, 3, 3, 3, 3)
  ) %>%
  merge_at(i = 1:2, j = 1, part = "header") %>%
  flextable::compose(                       # R2 -> R with superscript 2
    part = "header", i = 2, j = grep("_R2$", names(tbl)),
    value = as_paragraph("R", as_sup("2"))
  ) %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(part = "header", border = thick) %>%
  hline(i = 1, j = 2:ncol(tbl), part = "header", border = thin) %>%   # rule under model names
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = thin) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "body", border = thick) %>%
  align(align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  align(j = 1, align = "left", part = "all") %>%
  valign(j = 1, valign = "bottom", part = "header") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1) %>%       # stretch to page width
  fix_border_issues()

# Print table
perf_table
```
